Initial release: Generate 9:16 vertical short videos from Markdown scripts with TTS voiceover and subtitle synchronization.

- One-click script-to-video generation: parse Markdown scripts, create TTS audio, render slides, and assemble MP4s.
- Supports custom TTS voice and speed, subtitle burn-in, and using pre-designed images.
- Designed for individual creators; ideal for educational, product, and informational short videos.
- Command-line tool compatible with major platforms, requiring only Python 3.8+, FFmpeg, and Chrome.
- Free version: single video generation, default settings, no batch or advanced templating.
